Hi all —

Attached are the first drafts: May2027_KPI_dashboard.xlsx and May2027_vitals_summary.pdf. Quick highlights up front (sliceable by model/region in the sheet):

- Latency: P50 = 88 ms (down 4% vs Apr); P95 = 410 ms (flat). The P95 tail remains concentrated on long-context chat workloads from two customers.
- Cost: unit cost per 1M tokens = $11.8 (down 6% vs Apr) — majority of savings from the quantization pilot for medium-size LMs and smarter batching.
- Uptime: 99.98% for May. Two short blips totaling ~22 minutes on May 11 and May 19 due to maintenance window overlap and an autoscaler bug. No persistent customer impact recorded; support tickets auto-closed after retries.
- Usage: active token volume +22% MoM; peak concurrency increased 18% (Asia region contribution ~30% of the growth).

Open items I flagged in the doc: cost breakdown by instance type (tab 'COST_BREAKDOWN'), and a one-slide summary for RCA on the two blips (tab 'INCIDENT_SNAP'). Drive link below has the living dashboard with charts.
